name: e2e-deployment-skill
title_zh: 用 Playwright 启动时自动验证共享技能是否
tagline_zh: 每次跑端到端测试前，先替你确认共享技能真的挂上了。别等用例跑到一半才发现技能没加载，白等一场。
tagline_en: Before E2E tests run, verify shared skills actually load. Don't discover mid-run that they're missing and waste.
desc_en: Use this deployment skill to verify shared skills load during Playwright startup.
why_zh: 把「技能加载」变成启动期硬检查，而不是用例里的隐性假设。失败即停，省下整轮调试时间。
why_en: Turns skill loading into a hard startup check instead of an implicit assumption in tests. Fail fast, save a whole debug cycle.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 LibreChat 仓库里的共享技能加载验证；需要已有 Playwright 测试环境。不检查技能内容正确性。
limit_en: Only verifies shared skill loading in LibreChat repo; requires existing Playwright setup. Checks load action, not skill correctness.
